make writer-facing granularity repair feedback violation-only without replacement semantic roles/decomposition

compute global Goal-to-Capability coverage from requested outputs rather than writer-shaped legacy effect identity

forbidden_repairs: Do not add phrase-specific courier/phone exclusions as the primary fix.
Do not use similarity, embeddings, a fuzzy threshold, or an LLM mapper to grant capability execution authority.
Do not expose capability names, keys, availability, planner rules, discovery examples, exclusion examples or coverage counts to the pre-freeze Semantic Writer.
Do not allow validators to feed replacement semantic IDs, dependency graphs, target meanings, or Goal decomposition back to the writer.
Do not keep legacy requested_effect identity as a parallel execution authority for newly declared turns.
Do not weaken existing semantic, capability, transaction, oracle, or protected-source tests.
required_invariants: Pre-freeze writer input is capability-blind and sees only a semantic vocabulary that can include outputs with zero installed capabilities.
The sole writer emits/finalizes requested output semantics before capability discovery.
Validators expose only grounded violation feedback; replacement semantic values are not writer inputs.
New-turn capability completion requires exact coverage of all frozen requested outputs.
No exact completion coverage deterministically exposes only the unsupported path; nearest capability cannot execute.
Logistics status/ETA remain supported while courier contact remains unsupported under the same vocabulary.
Historical frozen checkpoints lacking the new output contract use an explicit compatibility-only path with deletion tests.
Goal completion evidence for new turns is classified from the same exact requested-output coverage proof.

counterexamples: courier contact phone is a valid frozen semantic output with zero completion capability and routes unsupported
supported logistics sibling plus unsupported courier sibling remain independent and do not collapse
validator mismatch feedback contains violation evidence but no replacement dependency/effect/role answer
focused: structural pre-freeze prompt/schema test contains no CapabilityRegistry-derived vocabulary or deployed-effect alignment instruction
exact output coverage tests for logistics status and ETA
negative_path: open output is never coerced to a registered capability
legacy effect identity cannot authorize a newly declared requested-output turn
capability semantic guidance cannot appear in the pre-freeze writer payload
regression: existing unified semantic planning contract suite
existing Capability v2 / module installation / Agent Quick regression
existing Business and Skill control-plane regression

risks: A capability-independent vocabulary that is too small could increase unsupported results; open outputs must remain valid and fail closed.
A too-broad capability coverage declaration could reintroduce semantic collapse; negative coverage tests must include unsupported siblings.
Legacy checkpoint compatibility could accidentally become a second new-turn authority; the cutover must be explicitly versioned/tested.
Changing requested-output validation can break direct unit fixtures; compatibility must be constrained to historical state, not provider-bound new declarations.
rollback_plan: Revert the complete A2/B migration commit set together, restoring the previous requested_effect exact matcher and writer prompts. Do not partially revert only the semantic vocabulary or only the matcher because the old/new join is one atomic correctness boundary.
strategy: Restore the existing single-writer ADR boundary in one atomic A2/B migration: expose only module-contributed capability-independent semantic vocabulary before freeze; freeze explicit requested outputs; keep validators violation-only; compile exact capability output coverage after freeze; preserve legacy effect identity only for already-frozen historical checkpoints; do not change target compilation in this batch.
unchanged_boundaries: Business Service remains the business-fact authority.
Draft/Grant/Attempt/Receipt transaction authority and structured interaction rules do not change.
Phase C deterministic historical-reference target compilation is not implemented in this batch.
No new ecommerce phrase/keyword classifier is introduced in Kernel or Runtime.
No new WP-08 ReleaseRun is started by this migration.
